name: How long does interior house painting usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior house painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior house painting varies based on the size of the area, the number of rooms, the condition of the walls, and the complexity of the project. A single room might take 1-2 days, including prep and drying time. A multi-room or entire house project could range from 3-7 days or more. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality, providing a more precise timeline after assessing your specific needs during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on scope, from 1-2 days for a single room to 3-7+ days for a full house. We provide a precise timeline after assessing your project.
